title: taVNS-coupling: reproducibility package for transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation cardiovascular coupling analysis
description: Reproducibility package for a study examining acute effects of transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation (taVNS) on cardiovascular coupling in healthy adult males (n=18). Contains beat-to-beat derived data, analysis pipeline, canonical results tables corresponding to the manuscript's Additional Files 2 and 3, and an anchor-metric tolerance verification mode. Raw waveform data is not included due to IRB restrictions.
